name: Kein Gottland
source:
Star Sign: Cancer
Image Stone: Aqua Aura, Moonstone

A Holy Knight whose specialty is water magic.
Aside from specific people he acts apathetic and he isn't good at showing emotions.
He doesn't talk much and it's hard to know what he's thinking.
